user.title: Set up Device Entity XLSX Export
user.description: Enables XLSX export for Home Assistant devices and their entities. No additional settings are required.

export_device.name: Export device entities to Excel
export_device.description: Exports all entities assigned to a selected Home Assistant device into an XLSX file.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device whose entities should be exported.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Optional filename. The .xlsx extension is added automatically.

include_disabled.name: Include disabled entities
include_disabled.description: Also exports disabled entity registry entries.

include_attributes.name: Include attributes
include_attributes.description: Adds current state attributes as JSON to the workbook.

device_not_found.message: The device with ID {device_id} was not found.

no_entities.message: No exportable entities were found for device {device_name}.
